مَضَى مِنَ اللَّيْلِ هَتْءٌ , and ↓ هِتْءٌ , (ISk, K,) and ↓ هَتِىْءٌ , (Lh, K,) and ↓ هَتِىٌّ , (Lh,) and ↓ هِتَاءٌ , and ↓ هِيتِئٌ (same measure as زِبْرِجٌ, as in the TA), or ↓ هِتْيَآءٌ , (as in the CK and a MS. copy) and ↓ هِيتَآءٌ , (K,) and ↓ هَتْأَةٌ , (AHeyth, K,) A portion of the night elapsed (K, &c.) ―
-b2- مَا بَقِىَ مِنْ غَنَمِهِمْ إِلَّا هِتْءٌ There remained not, of their sheep, or goats, save a part, less than the part that had gone away. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
